body: """# Colors 颜色类 (HEX 十六进制颜色值)
content: flet.Control | None = None,  # 容器的内容
align: flet.Alignment | None = None,  # 容器本身相对于父级控件的对齐方式[TOP_LEFT(-1, -1), CENTER(0, 0), BOTTOM_RIGHT(1, 1)]
alignment: flet.Alignment | None = None,  # 容器内子容器或子控件对齐方式[TOP_LEFT(-1, -1), CENTER(0, 0), BOTTOM_RIGHT(1, 1)]
padding: flet.PaddingValue | None = None,  # 内边距
bgcolor: flet.ColorValue | None = None,  # 背景颜色
opacity: flet.Number = 1.0,  # 不透明度[0.0(完全透明) - 1.0(完全不透明)]
border: flet.Border | None = None,  # 边框样式
border_radius: flet.BorderRadiusValue | None = None,  # 边框半径(及 边框圆角)
shadow: flet.BoxShadowValue | None = None,  # 阴影
width: flet.Number | None = None,  # 宽度
height: flet.Number | None = None,  # 高度
left: flet.Number | None = None,  # 子组件左边缘(距离容器 Stack 左侧向内缩进)距离
top: flet.Number | None = None,  # 子组件上边缘(距离容器 Stack 上侧向内缩进)距离
right: flet.Number | None = None,  # 子组件右边缘(距离容器 Stack 右侧向内缩进)距离
bottom: flet.Number | None = None,  # 子组件下边缘(距离容器 Stack 下侧向内缩进)距离
animate_position: flet.AnimationValue | None = None,  # 隐式动画[Animation(duration:持续时间, curve:曲线[AnimationCurve.<LINEAR>])]
expand: bool | int | None = None,  # 填充
col: flet.ResponsiveNumber = 12,  # 在 ResponsiveRow 容器内占比 ([1-12] / 12)
on_click: flet.ControlEventHandler[flet.Container] | None = None,  # 点击触发事件
content (flet.Control | None, optional): 容器的内容. Defaults to None.
align (flet.Alignment | None, optional): 容器本身相对于父级控件的对齐方式[TOP_LEFT(-1, -1), CENTER(0, 0), BOTTOM_RIGHT(1, 1)]. Defaults to None.
alignment (flet.Alignment | None, optional): 容器内子容器或子控件对齐方式[TOP_LEFT(-1, -1), CENTER(0, 0), BOTTOM_RIGHT(1, 1)]. Defaults to None.
padding (flet.PaddingValue | None, optional): 内边距. Defaults to None.
bgcolor (flet.ColorValue | None, optional): 背景颜色. Defaults to None.
opacity (flet.Number): 不透明度[0.0(完全透明) - 1.0(完全不透明)]. Defaults to 1.0.
border (flet.Border | None, optional): 边框样式. Defaults to None.
border_radius (flet.BorderRadiusValue | None): 边框半径(及 边框圆角). Defaults to None.
shadow (flet.BoxShadowValue | None = None): 阴影[BoxShadow(spread_radius:扩散半径, blur_radius:模糊半径, color:阴影颜色)]. Defaults to None.
width (flet.Number | None): 宽度. Defaults to None.
height (flet.Number | None): 高度. Defaults to None.
left (flet.Number | None): 子组件左边缘(距离容器 Stack 左侧向内缩进)距离. Defaults to None.
top (flet.Number | None): 子组件上边缘(距离容器 Stack 上侧向内缩进)距离. Defaults to None.
right (flet.Number | None): 子组件右边缘(距离容器 Stack 右侧向内缩进)距离. Defaults to None.
bottom (flet.Number | None): 子组件下边缘(距离容器 Stack 下侧向内缩进)距离. Defaults to None.
animate_position (flet.AnimationValue | None): 隐式动画[Animation(duration:持续时间, curve:曲线[AnimationCurve.<LINEAR>])]. Defaults to None.
expand (bool | int | None, optional): 填充. Defaults to None.
col (flet.ResponsiveNumber, optional): 在 ResponsiveRow 容器内占比 ([1-12] / 12). Defaults to 12.
on_click (flet.ControlEventHandler[Container] | None): 点击触发事件. Defaults to None.
value: str = '',  # 显示的文本内容
text_align: flet.TextAlign = flet.TextAlign.START,  # 文本水平对齐
font_family: str | None = 'Microsoflet YaHei',  # 使用系统或自定义字体族来渲染文本
size: flet.Number | None = 16,  # 文本大小(单位:像素)
weight: flet.FontWeight | None = None,  # 字体粗细
color: flet.ColorValue | None = None,  # 文本的前景色颜色
bgcolor: flet.ColorValue | None = None,  # 文本的背景颜色
expand: bool | int | None = None,  # 文本填充
col: flet.ResponsiveNumber = 12,  # 在 ResponsiveRow 容器内占比 ([1-12] / 12)
value (str, optional): 显示的文本内容. Defaults to ''.
text_align (flet.TextAlign, optional): 文本水平对齐. Defaults to flet.TextAlign.START.
font_family (str | None, optional): 使用系统或自定义字体族来渲染文本. Defaults to 'Microsoflet YaHei'.
size (flet.Number | None, optional): 文本大小(单位:像素). Defaults to 16.
weight (flet.FontWeight | None, optional): 字体粗细. Defaults to None.
color (flet.ColorValue | None, optional): 文本的前景色颜色. Defaults to None.
bgcolor (flet.ColorValue | None, optional): 文本的背景颜色. Defaults to None.
expand (bool | int | None, optional): 文本填充. Defaults to None.
col (flet.ResponsiveNumber, optional): 在 ResponsiveRow 容器内占比 ([1-12] / 12). Defaults to 12.
content: flet.StrOrControl | None = None,  # 按钮显示文字内容
icon: flet.IconDataOrControl | None = None,  # 按钮文字前显示 ICON 图标
color: flet.ColorValue | None = None,  # 按钮前景色 (ICON & 文本)
icon_color: flet.ColorValue | None = None,  # 按钮内 ICON 图标颜色
style: flet.ButtonStyle | None = flet.ButtonStyle(  # 按钮风格样式
side=flet.BorderSide(color=flet.Colors.BLACK_12),  # 边框 flet.BorderSide(width=[粗细], color=[颜色])
expand: bool | int | None = None,  # 填充
col: flet.ResponsiveNumber = 12,  # 在 ResponsiveRow 容器内占比 ([1-12] / 12)
content (flet.StrOrControl | None, optional): 按钮显示文字内容. Defaults to None.
icon (flet.IconDataOrControl | None, optional): 按钮文字前显示 ICON 图标. Defaults to None.
color (flet.ColorValue | None, optional): 按钮前景色 (ICON & 文本). Defaults to None.
icon_color (flet.ColorValue | None, optional): 按钮内 ICON 图标颜色. Defaults to None.
style (flet.ButtonStyle | None, optional): 按钮风格样式. Defaults to flet.ButtonStyle(side=flet.BorderSide(color=flet.Colors.BLACK_12), shape=flet.RoundedRectangleBorder(radius=12)).
[side=flet.BorderSide:边框 flet.BorderSide(width=[粗细], color=[颜色]), shape=flet.RoundedRectangleBorder:圆角 flet.RoundedRectangleBorder(radius=[圆角半径])]
expand (bool | int | None, optional): 填充. Defaults to None.
col (flet.ResponsiveNumber, optional): 在 ResponsiveRow 容器内占比 ([1-12] / 12). Defaults to 12.
label: flet.StrOrControl | None = None,  # 显示在复选框右侧标签内容(建议使用 Text 实例，不受 disabled 样式影响)
label_style: flet.TextStyle | None = None,  # 标签内容文本样式
value: bool | None = False,  # 复选框的值 [True | False | None]
tristate: bool = False,  # 复选框拥有 3 种状态 [False(默认)状态:True/False; True状态:True/False/None]
splash_radius: flet.Number | None = 0,  # 复选框圆形材质墨水反馈状态范围 [单位:像素] (0:不显示反馈视效)
check_color: flet.ColorValue | None = flet.Colors.WHITE,  # 复选框选中状态标志颜色
active_color: flet.ColorValue | None = flet.Colors.GREEN,  # 复选框选中状态填充颜色 (会被 fill_color 配置覆盖)
hover_color: flet.ColorValue | None = flet.Colors.TRANSPARENT,  # 复选框被悬停状态高亮颜色 (会被 overlay_color 配置覆盖)
border_side: flet.ControlStateValue[flet.BorderSide] | None = flet.BorderSide(width=2, color=flet.Colors.BLACK),  # 复选框边框样式
fill_color: flet.ControlStateValue[flet.ColorValue] | None = {  # 复选框填充颜色 [ControlState.SELECTED = active_color 配置状态]
overlay_color: flet.ControlStateValue[flet.ColorValue] | None = None,  # 复选框覆盖层(悬停|点击 时的颜色反馈)颜色 [TRANSPARENT 透明]
disabled: bool = False,  # 禁用控件 [False:启用, True:禁用]
opacity: flet.Number = 1,  # 不透明度[0.0(完全透明) - 1.0(完全不透明)]
col: flet.ResponsiveNumber = 12,  # 在 ResponsiveRow 容器内占比 ([1-12] / 12)
label (flet.StrOrControl | None, optional): 显示在复选框右侧标签内容(建议使用 Text 实例，不受 disabled 样式影响). Defaults to None.
label_style (flet.TextStyle | None, optional): 标签内容文本样式. Defaults to None.
value (bool | None, optional): 复选框的值 [True | False | None]. Defaults to False.
tristate (bool, optional): 复选框拥有 3 种状态 [False(默认)状态:True/False; True状态:True/False/None]. Defaults to False.
splash_radius (flet.Number | None, optional): 复选框圆形材质墨水反馈状态范围 [单位:像素] (0:不显示反馈视效). Defaults to 0.
check_color (flet.ColorValue | None, optional): 复选框选中状态标志颜色. Defaults to flet.Colors.WHITE.
active_color (flet.ColorValue | None, optional): 复选框选中状态填充颜色 (会被 fill_color 配置覆盖). Defaults to flet.Colors.GREEN.
hover_color (flet.ColorValue | None, optional): 复选框被悬停状态高亮颜色 (会被 overlay_color 配置覆盖). Defaults to flet.Colors.TRANSPARENT.
border_side (flet.ControlStateValue[flet.BorderSide] | None, optional): 复选框边框样式. Defaults to flet.BorderSide(width=2, color=flet.Colors.BLACK).

fill_color (flet.ControlStateValue[flet.ColorValue] | None, optional): 复选框填充颜色 (ControlState.SELECTED = active_color 配置状态). Defaults to {flet.ControlState.DEFAULT: flet.Colors.WHITE, flet.ControlState.SELECTED: flet.Colors.GREEN, flet.ControlState.DISABLED: flet.Colors.WHITE}.
{flet.ControlState.DEFAULT:默认状态, flet.ControlState.SELECTED:选中状态, flet.ControlState.DISABLED:禁用状态}
overlay_color (flet.ControlStateValue[flet.ColorValue] | None, optional): 复选框覆盖层(悬停|点击 时的颜色反馈)颜色 [TRANSPARENT 透明]. Defaults to None.
disabled (bool, optional): 控件启用状态. Defaults to False.
opacity (flet.Number, optional): 不透明度[0.0(完全透明) - 1.0(完全不透明)]. Defaults to 1.
col (flet.ResponsiveNumber, optional): 在 ResponsiveRow 容器内占比 ([1-12] / 12). Defaults to 12.
value='AlertDialog Title', size=22, weight=flet.FontWeight.BOLD, font_family='Microsoft YaHei'
),  # 对话框标题[建议:定义独立 Text 控件]
content: flet.Control | None = flet.Row(controls=[flet.ProgressRing(), flet.Text(value='AlertDialog Content')]),  # 对话框内容
modal: bool = False,  # 模态:通过点击对话框外部的某个区域来关闭或 dismiss 对话框 [False(默认):允许; True:禁止]
actions: list[flet.Control] = [flet.TextButton(content='Dismiss')],  # 对话框底部的操作区域
"""# Dialog (继承 flet.AlertDialog) 对话框控件
**当 modal=True 时, 可以使用 `page.show_dialog(dialog=<AlertDialog>)`:显示对话框，并管理其关闭生命周期 / `page.pop_dialog()`:关闭最近打开的对话框**
title (flet.StrOrControl | None, optional): 对话框标题[建议:定义独立 Text 控件]. Defaults to flet.Text(value='AlertDialog Title', size=22, weight=flet.FontWeight.BOLD, font_family='Microsoft YaHei').
content (flet.Control | None, optional): 对话框内容. Defaults to flet.Row(controls=[flet.ProgressRing(), flet.Text(value='AlertDialog Content')]).
modal (bool, optional): 模态:通过点击对话框外部的某个区域来关闭或 dismiss 对话框 [False(默认):允许; True:禁止]. Defaults to False.
actions (list[flet.Control], optional): 对话框底部的操作区域. Defaults to [flet.TextButton(content='Dismiss')].
